description: Cached values of cells of OTHER workbooks that this document's formulas refer to (node type core.sheet.external-values, node_id `external-values`). A formula such as `[1]Sheet1!$A$1` reads cell A1 of sheet Sheet1 of external workbook number 1. That workbook is NOT part of this file and can never be fetched from it (law 1): what travels is the values the application last saw, here. This node is DERIVED from the preserved source part and is stamped `measured`.

books.description: The external workbooks, in the order formulas number them.

number.description: The number formulas use for this workbook: 1 for `[1]`, 2 for `[2]`, ...

origin.description: Where the other workbook was when the values were cached, as recorded by the application that cached them. A NOTE about provenance only: nothing in this document depends on it, and a reader MUST NOT try to open it.

sheets.description: The sheets of the external workbook for which values are cached.

cells.description: The cached cells, in the order of the source part.

kind.description: The type of `value`: number (a JSON number), text (a string), boolean (true/false), error (a string such as `#N/A`), empty (null).

ref.description: The cell's address in A1 notation (ONE-BASED row number).

value.description: The cached value. Content, never a reference.

name.description: The sheet's name. Free text: content, never a reference - a reader shows or stores it and never resolves it as a path or address.

schema_version.description: Revision of this payload's schema. Always 1 in profile spreadsheet/1.

title: core.sheet.external-values - cached values of external workbooks
